name: Triage
label: Quest
description: Triage: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Good day, doctor. You will be tested on your ability to triage patients accordingly this afternoon. Should you pass your examination, you will join the prestigious ranks of Alliance Trauma.

Now pay attention! The critically injured must be tended to first. After the criticals come the badly injured. The injured should be tended to last. You must save 15 patients to pass this exam. You will fail should 6 of your patients die in triage.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Doctor friend, welcome to Alliance Trauma.
